title: The Golden Mule
rumor: The Golden Mule. A half-starved pack mule wandered into a mining camp carrying saddlebags filled with extraordinarily pure gold nuggets. No owner ever came forward. The animal repeatedly tried to return to the mountains but refused to follow any established trail, and its hooves bore traces of a strange black mineral.
first_lead: The mule's former handlers left an account of its behavior at a prospectors' lodging house.
